rules.description: SYN attempt to the control channel.
USER bytes are present on the control transport; successful authentication requires the corresponding response.
PASV or 227 bytes are present; verify the parsed passive endpoint separately.
SYN attempt to a port in the passive range.
Payload-bearing TCP segment in the passive port range; verify the transferred file separately.
SHA-256 or HASH bytes are present; compare full digests to establish integrity.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3: Assert successful authentication and parse the advertised reachable data endpoint.
R4 R5: Verify bytes and completion status against the requested file.
R6: A HASH/SHA-256 marker is only presence evidence; compare the complete digest values.
